name: Cheeca Lodge & Spa
positioning: A 27-acre oceanfront resort in Islamorada in the Florida Keys, in Islamorada since 1946, with a beach, pools, golf and water sports
best_for: Couples wanting an oceanfront suite with a private soaking tub
Families wanting a beach, a family pool and water sports

facts.text: Cheeca Lodge & Spa is a 27-acre oceanfront resort in Islamorada.
Cheeca Lodge & Spa has been in Islamorada since 1946.
The resort has a 9-hole golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus.
The resort has two oceanfront swimming pools.
The resort has a free-form family pool and a 1,200-foot beach.
Guests can kayak along the coast or go on a scuba excursion.
The resort offers fishing charters and tournaments.
The resort has tennis courts and tropical gardens.
The Resort View Bungalow has a vaulted wood beam ceiling and classic Florida Keys decor.
The Islamorada Suite has a hidden outdoor soaking tub with a shower.
Atlantic's Edge serves fresh seafood and prime-aged steaks overlooking the ocean.
Nikai serves handcrafted sushi with a curated sake list.

highlights.text: The premier oceanfront suites have unobstructed views of the Atlantic Ocean and a large open-air balcony with a private soaking tub.
Guests can go snorkeling on North America's living coral barrier reef.
The Oceanfront Two Bedroom Casita includes butler service and looks out over the Atlantic Ocean and the private beach.
The Lagoon View rooms have easy access to Spa Island.
The Lagoon View One Bedroom Suite looks onto the Lagoon Waterfall.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the island location means a longer journey to reach the resort.
WhataHotel notes hurricane season may affect travel plans in the summer months.
The Golf Course One Bedroom Suite is also available as a pet-friendly room.
